review.note: 2026-11-22 Asia/Taipei h2h-dev-tools 0.14.2 dependency review. All satisfy the unchanged lower-only bounds; no latest stable candidate lies outside those bounds. Python artifact Requires-Python metadata admits 3.14 and latest releases are not wholly yanked; distlib omits Requires-Python but advertises 3.14, while xdist requires >=3.9 without a 3.14 classifier. npm requires Node >=22. Re-read the current official release notes: Hatchling adds Python 3.15 support; distlib fixes marker bounds, launcher handling and archive filtering; packaging adds range APIs and fixes requirements/markers while dropping Python 3.8; build repairs Windows symlink detection; mypy uses native parsing and fixes overload handling; pytest changes plugin import failure codes, parametrization keywords and assertion-cache validation; xdist adds loadscope-order control; Ruff corrects duplicate/assignment analysis and F841 handling; markdownlint-cli2 updates dependencies. No concrete incompatibility requiring a bound change or exclusion was identified. Candidate local Python 3.14.8 author checks passed 49 related tests (4 host-filesystem skips), strict mypy, Ruff and Markdown lint. These are distinct from metadata review and do not prove all runtime/platform combinations; complete gate/artifacts and native Windows CI remain separate. No dependency or bound changes in this release. Minimum-release metadata was not re-fetched, and transitive packages were not individually audited.
